inspectedText: U235 can absorb a neutron and fission into lighter nuclei, releasing heat and additional neutrons. Under appropriate conditions sufficient uranium enables a continuing chain reaction. Electrical generation requires additional engineered plant machinery; geological fission is not evidence of electricity generation.
